description: This file implements email sending functionality for Mattermost, including SMTP configuration, authentication, connection handling, and email composition with embedded files.

classes.name: SMTPConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for SMTP server connection and email sending options.

classes.name: mailData
classes.description: Structure holding email message details such as recipients, subject, body, and embedded files.

classes.name: smtpClient
classes.description: Interface representing an SMTP client with methods for mail transactions.

classes.name: authChooser
classes.description: Custom SMTP authentication handler that chooses between different auth methods.

methods.name: encodeRFC2047Word
methods.description: Encodes a string in RFC 2047 MIME header encoding.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Method for authChooser to start SMTP authentication, selecting PLAIN or LOGIN.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Method for loginAuth to initiate LOGIN authentication, verifying server and host.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Method for loginAuth to handle server prompts during LOGIN authentication.

methods.name: ConnectToSMTPServerAdvanced
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to SMTP server with optional TLS security.

methods.name: ConnectToSMTPServer
methods.description: Wrapper for connecting to SMTP server, calls advanced connection method.

methods.name: NewSMTPClientAdvanced
methods.description: Creates a new SMTP client with optional STARTTLS and authentication.

methods.name: NewSMTPClient
methods.description: Wrapper for creating SMTP client, calls advanced method.

methods.name: TestConnection
methods.description: Tests SMTP server connectivity and authentication.

methods.name: SendMailWithEmbeddedFilesUsingConfig
methods.description: Sends an email with embedded files using specified SMTP configuration.

methods.name: SendMailUsingConfig
methods.description: Sends an email without embedded files using specified SMTP configuration.

methods.name: sendMailUsingConfigAdvanced
methods.description: Performs the actual email sending process with SMTP client and message data.

methods.name: sendMail
methods.description: Constructs and transmits the email message via SMTP client, including headers and embedded files.
